title: Finite-difference zeta readout of one-loop operator spectra
summary: For a positive elliptic operator $A$, the logarithmic zeta determinant $\ln\det_ζA=-ζ_{A}'(0)$ combines UV information encoded by local heat-kernel coefficients with finite contributions determined by the full spectrum. We introduce a finite-difference zeta readout based on $ζ_{A}(0)$ and $ζ_{A}(q-1)$, defining a one-parameter meromorphic family whose node-coalescence limit $q\to 1$ recovers the standard logarithmic zeta determinant.
